name: ent-clearing
description: The settlement layer of ledger row #12, executed: the coin, the notary, and the binding market were already books — this page is the CLEARING. Redemption: teleportation burns the coin to deliver an unknown qubit (fidelity exact over pure and mixed payloads; post-trade pairwise concurrence exactly 0; the goods do not move until the 2-bit classical leg settles — Bob's pre-bits marginal is exactly I/2). Reverse quote: dense coding buys exactly 2 cbits with 1 transmitted qubit and RETURNS the coin as a known Bell pair (post-decode concurrence exactly 1) — fuel in one trade and catalyst in the other, and that asymmetry is the parity 1 ebit = 1 qubit = 2 cbits. Netting: a weak coin of concurrence 2*sqrt(l0*l1) nets to a standard coin with probability exactly 2*l_min (Procrustean filter, exact), and v0.2.0 executes MIXED-coin netting at bounded exact scale: the BBPSSW recurrence round on 16x16 kernels at n = 2, 3, 4 coins (closed forms recompute to 1e-12; the depolarizing step realized as the exact 24-element local-Clifford isotropic twirl, machine-measured load-bearing; never a standard coin at bounded scale; the asymptotic hashing line stays quoted with honest gap accounting). The conservation ledger: the catalyst's E_F conserved exactly, the fuel's burned exactly (delta -1), every netting and purification row never rises (Vidal00 instantiated per op). The multi-party desk: a 3-party GHZ bank where C's X-measurement plus 1 cbit withdraws a known standard coin onto any pairwise ledger (exact), the mint wall survives per cut (negativity census, VW02 cited) and fails on the pairwise ledger (exact counterexample). The mint wall: local channels never raise E_F (census), a single global CNOT mints C 0->1 — the clearing house moves, spends, nets; it never prints. The checker enforces the board laws (H1-H8, including yield-table provenance and conservation-identity honesty); the renderer refuses illegal boards, yield tables, ledgers, and claim tables.
